title: ChronoCard: compact pool forecast & cost-anchored burst controls
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: Design and prototype a compact, single-row "ChronoCard" for the Dedicated Capacity console that surfaces GPU pool health, a short-term forecast of demand and cost, and a cost-anchored burst control that ties directly into rollout/canary controls. The card should work as a dense overview for operators and a lightweight entry-point to the full Pool Detail page. Focus constraints: legibility at small sizes, accessible color contrast for health states, and clear affordances for confirming burst and canary rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: ChronoCard displays three telemetry lines (utilization, queued work, cost forecast) as compact sparklines with per-series legend and hover tooltip
Cost anchor appears as a small configurable baseline (USD/hr) and estimated delta when burst is applied
Burst control allows a quick 'momentary burst' (minutes) and 'policy suggestion' (recommended minutes/capacity) with projected cost impact shown before confirmation
Card integrates a small rollout CTA that launches the existing canary flow and pre-fills the burst window when a burst is selected
Prototype includes responsive variants for sidebar lists, grid cards, and a full Pool Detail header slot
Design has been reviewed by PM and Eng with documented feedback and sign-off, accessibility color contrast passes AA for text and icons
decisions: Priority given to compactness: detailed metrics moved to Pool Detail page but a hover gives quick metric snapshots
Forecast window limited to 1h and 24h presets to avoid model complexity; backend to provide both so UI can toggle
Burst confirmation uses explicit cost delta and a short natural-language summary to reduce accidental bursts
We will surface per-route cost links in a secondary overflow menu rather than in the primary card to keep focus

2025-02-22 - Design critique (team): Reduce label density, increase hit area for burst control, and update health states to use single icon + color. Action: Arjun to produce hi-fi with updated affordances.

2025-03-01 - Accessibility review by Mei Zhang: Contrast on forecast line markers fails for small sizes; suggest thicker stroke and alternative markers. Recommend keyboard focus state for burst action.

2025-03-04 - Arjun Patel (Assignee): Updated Figma prototype with thicker sparklines, cost anchor edit flow, and rollout pre-fill. Pushed prototype link and requested In Review status. Preparing handoff notes for ENG-88214 and ENG-88300.
notes: This ticket is intentionally scoped as a surface-level compact card to serve list views and headers. The Pool Detail expansion and deep analytics are tracked separately (PM-4322). Backend forecasting endpoints are required; coordinate with ENG-88214 for contract. Ensure audit events for burst are included in ENG-88300.
